detail: Reserve Bank of Fiji Press Release No. 16/2022 presenting the Bank's audited financial statements for the financial year ended 31 July 2022 states that the statements were 'certified by the external auditors, KPMG'. The press release names no individual signing partner; the auditor's report pages in the RBF annual report itself extract as images only.
source_title: Press Release No. 16/2022 - Reserve Bank of Fiji presents its audited financial statements for the 2021-2022 financial year

detail: The independent auditor's report accompanying the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic's consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025, published in the Bank's Annual Report for 2025, is issued by Baker Tilly Bishkek LLC of Bishkek, Kyrgyz Republic, and is dated 18 February 2026.
source_title: Annual Report of the National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic for 2025 (consolidated financial statements and independent auditor's report)

detail: The Corporate Information page of the Central Bank of The Gambia's Annual Report and Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2021 lists the Bank's auditors as 'PKF Gambia', 33 Bijilo Layout Annex, Bijilo, The Gambia, and 'PKF Nigeria', PKF House, 205A Ikorodu Road, Obanikoro, Lagos, Nigeria - a joint engagement of the two PKF member firms. The report's own 'Independent Audit Opinion' pages (11-16) extract as classification footers only, so the signature and date could not be read; the firm names come from the Bank's own corporate information page in the same document.
source_title: Central Bank of The Gambia Annual Report and Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2021

detail: The Independent Auditors' Report on the Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2016, dated 29 March 2017, is headed 'Grant Thornton d.o.o. Banja Luka'; the signature block also carries 'Grant Thornton sh.p.k.' with offices in Skopje and Tirana. Read from a full-text mirror of the CBBH's own 'Independent Auditors' Report and Financial Statements' publication; the CBBH's current listing pages and its 2023 Governing Board press release name no auditor.
source_title: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina: Independent Auditors' Report and Financial Statements
